Overview.Name: Aishwarya
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + sauted vegetables
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & chicken (120 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) or Paneer cubes + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Use gym days to prioritize protein like eggs and chicken in earlier meals.
Start meals with protein before rice to support fat loss.
During social gatherings, eat your main meal first to avoid overeating snacks.
Keep dinner lighter to support fat loss and recovery.
Consistency in meals and workouts will improve body shape and energy.
Get sunlight exposure in the morning which will improve your sleep and improving sleep will significantly improve energy and control cravings.
